name: Candlelighter
flavor: She lights one for every heart that ever burned.
description: +{mult} Mult per scored Heart. Hearts held in hand give +1 Mult each.

name: Tithe Box
flavor: A tenth of everything, and the box never fills.
description: +{chips} Chips per scored Diamond. Each scored Diamond has a 1 in 8 chance to give $1.

name: Oak Cudgel
flavor: Blunt, heavy, and very persuasive.
description: +{mult} Mult per scored Club.

name: Sexton's Spade
flavor: Digs deep. Asks no questions.
description: +{chips} Chips and +{mult} Mult per scored Spade.

name: Portrait Gallery
flavor: Every face on the wall is judging your hand.
description: +{chips} Chips per scored face card.

name: Courtiers
flavor: They hover. They whisper. They never leave.
description: Face cards held in hand give +{mult} Mult each.

name: Pennywhistle
flavor: Three notes, over and over, from the cheap seats.
description: Scored 2s, 3s and 4s give +{mult} Mult each.

name: Abacus
flavor: Beads click. Somewhere, a sum is settled.
description: +{chips} Chips per scored numbered card (2 through 10).

name: Dyer's Vat
flavor: Everything comes out the same colour eventually.
description: +{chips} Chips if the played hand contains a Flush.

name: Pilgrim's Road
flavor: One step after another, all the way to the shrine.
description: +{mult} Mult if the played hand contains a Straight.

name: Mason's Ladder
flavor: Each rung was set by the one before it.
description: If the played hand contains a Straight, each scored card gives +{chips} Chips.

name: Twin Bells
flavor: Cast from one mould; they ring in unison.
description: When the played hand is a Pair, each scored card retriggers once.

name: Solitary Lamp
flavor: Just enough light to read one card by.
description: High Card hands give +{chips} Chips and +{mult} Mult.

name: Moss Stone
flavor: It gathers something after all.
description: Gains +4 Chips every time a hand is played. Never resets. Currently +{counter} Chips.

name: Ivy Creep
flavor: Cut it back and it comes twice as eager.
description: Gains +1 Mult per card discarded. Halved when a blind ends. Currently +{counter} Mult.

name: Alms Bowl
flavor: Hold it out long enough and someone fills it.
description: Earn ${money} at the end of each round, plus $3 more if it was a boss blind.

name: Beggar's Cup
flavor: Rattles hopefully whenever anything is thrown away.
description: Each discarded card has a 1 in 5 chance to give ${money}.

name: Pawnbroker
flavor: Everything is worth a little more to somebody.
description: Your Jokers sell for $2 more. Interest cap raised by $5.

name: Wide Sleeves
flavor: Room for two more cards and one fewer excuse.
description: +2 hand size. -1 Discard.

name: Chaff Sack
flavor: What's left after threshing still counts.
description: +1 Discard. +10 Chips per Discard remaining when a hand is scored.

name: Bellows
flavor: More breath for the fire, less for the sweeping.
description: +1 Hand. -1 Discard.

name: Last Rites
flavor: With nothing left to throw away, everything is said twice.
description: While you have 0 Discards remaining, each scored card retriggers once.

name: Glazier
flavor: He handles the fragile things with a certain relish.
description: Scored Crystal cards give an extra x{xmult} Mult.

name: Anvil
flavor: Does nothing but sit there. That is the point.
description: Iron cards held in hand give +{mult} Mult each.

name: Cornerstone
flavor: Laid first, forgotten last.
description: Scored Slab cards give +{chips} Chips.

name: Mosaic
flavor: Every altered tile is one more piece of the picture.
description: +{mult} Mult per scored card with an enhancement.

name: Moths
flavor: Something is eating the deck. It leaves coins.
description: Each scored card has a 1 in 6 chance to be destroyed. You earn ${money} each time.

name: Coin Toss
flavor: Call it in the air.
description: 1 in 3 chance for x{xmult} Mult.

name: Empty Pew
flavor: The fewer who come, the louder the sermon.
description: +25 Chips per empty Joker slot.

name: Open Door
flavor: Nobody in, nobody out, plenty of room.
description: +4 Mult per empty Joker slot.

name: Doorkeeper
flavor: First in line or last to leave. Never the middle.
description: +40 Chips if this is your leftmost Joker. +4 Mult if it is your rightmost.

name: Overflowing Cup
flavor: Pour early, while there is still something to spill.
description: +15 Chips per Hand remaining.

name: Novice
flavor: Eager, unremarkable, always available.
description: +{mult} Mult.

name: Kindred
flavor: Three of anything is a family.
description: +{chips} Chips if the played hand contains a Three of a Kind.

name: Royal Court
flavor: The King speaks, the Queen counts, the Jack does it twice.
description: Scored Kings give +5 Mult, Queens give +40 Chips, and Jacks retrigger once.

name: Masquerade
flavor: Behind the masks, everyone is nobility.
description: During boss blinds every card counts as a face card. +{mult} Mult per scored face card.

name: Kindling
flavor: Small sticks burn hottest, and briefly.
description: Scored 2s to 5s give +{mult} Mult each, and each has a 1 in 4 chance to burn up.

name: Stained Glass
flavor: Four panes are enough to tell the story.
description: Flushes can be made with 4 cards. +{mult} Mult if the played hand contains a Flush.

name: Monochrome
flavor: One colour, held with conviction.
description: x{xmult} Mult if the played hand contains a Flush.

name: Twin Dye
flavor: Red is red. Black is black. The rest is detail.
description: Hearts and Diamonds count as one suit; Clubs and Spades count as one suit. +{chips} Chips on Flushes.

name: Rope Bridge
flavor: One plank missing. Keep walking.
description: Straights may skip one rank (4-5-7-8-9 counts). +{chips} Chips if the hand contains a Straight.

name: Vow of Silence
flavor: Say less. Mean it.
description: x{xmult} Mult if 2 or fewer cards are played.

name: Refrain
flavor: The same two notes, and they love it every time.
description: x{xmult} Mult if the played hand is a Pair or Two Pair.

name: Reliquary
flavor: Every spent miracle leaves a bone behind.
description: Gains x0.1 Mult each time a consumable is used. Currently x{counter} Mult.

name: Kiln
flavor: What goes in as clay comes out as heat.
description: Gains x0.1 Mult each time a card is destroyed. Currently x{counter} Mult.

name: Bazaar
flavor: More stalls, cheaper haggling.
description: +1 shop slot. Rerolls cost $1 less.

name: Winnowing Fan
flavor: Play small and the chaff blows off on its own.
description: After you play a hand of 3 or fewer cards, gain +1 Discard for this blind.

name: Choir Loft
flavor: A sealed letter, sung twice.
description: Each scored card with a seal retriggers once.

name: Antiphon
flavor: Call, and the walls answer.
description: If 3 or fewer cards are played, each scored card retriggers once.

name: Quarry
flavor: Heavy work, but the stones keep coming.
description: +20 Chips per Slab card in your deck. Scored Slab cards retrigger once.

name: Shard Collector
flavor: She keeps the pieces. She says they still count.
description: Whenever a Crystal card shatters, create a random Arcana card if there is room.

name: Pyre
flavor: The low cards go first. They always do.
description: Held 2s to 5s have a 1 in 3 chance to burn after scoring. +2 Mult per card burned. Now +{counter} Mult.

name: Fortune's Wheel
flavor: Round it goes; where it stops, you pay or get paid.
description: After each hand: 1 in 3 chance to earn $2, and 1 in 12 chance to level up the played hand.

name: Shell Game
flavor: Three shells, one pea, and the house is watching.
description: 1 in 4 chance for x{xmult} Mult.

name: Hermit
flavor: Company is overrated.
description: x{xmult} Mult if you have 2 or fewer Jokers.

name: Steady Stride
flavor: Never sprint at the start of a long road.
description: +4 Mult per Hand remaining.

name: Least of These
flavor: The smallest are counted first, and counted most.
description: Each scored card of rank 5 or lower gives x{xmult} Mult.

name: Seamless Robe
flavor: Woven in one piece. No seams, no suits, no argument.
description: Every card counts as every suit. -1 hand size.

name: Ascension
flavor: The climb ends where the ladder does: at the top.
description: An Ace scored as part of a Straight gives x{xmult} Mult.

name: Anchorite
flavor: Walled in with one card and a great deal of time.
description: After you play a High Card or a Pair, level up that hand type.

name: Hourglass
flavor: It never turns over. It only fills.
description: Gains x0.1 Mult every time a hand is played. Never resets. Currently x{counter} Mult.

name: Golden Calf
flavor: They melted the treasury down and worshipped it.
description: +x0.02 Mult for every $1 you have. At $50 that is x2 Mult.

name: Mirror Chapel
flavor: Every card in your hand has a twin on the far wall.
description: Retrigger every card held in hand once. +1 hand size.

name: Hollow Reed
flavor: Empty inside, and that is what makes it sing.
description: x1.5 Mult if your deck has 30 or fewer cards. x2 more if it has 20 or fewer (x3 total).

name: Patron of Fools
flavor: Luck is a saint like any other. She just takes bribes.
description: Every '1 in N' chance in the game is twice as likely to succeed. Charm cards included.

effects.description: All chance checks (jokers, Charm cards, Crystal shatter, consumables) use num*2 (capped at den).

name: Solitary Cell
flavor: One occupant. Very strong opinions.
description: x{xmult} Mult if this is your only Joker.

name: Vigil
flavor: The night is long. Keep a candle back for the end.
description: +1 Hand. +x0.25 Mult per Hand remaining.

name: Doppel
flavor: Stands behind his elder and does everything he does.
description: Copies the abilities of the Joker directly to its left.

effects.description: Runs every non-passive effect of the Joker immediately to its left as if it were its own.

name: The Bellfounder
flavor: Every hand you play, she casts a larger bell.
description: Every time you play a hand, level up that hand type.

name: The Illuminator
flavor: Gold leaf on every page, given time.
description: After scoring, each scored card without an edition has a 1 in 4 chance to gain a random edition.

effects.description: After each hand, each scored card with no edition rolls 1 in 4 to gain Gleam, Prism or Aurora.

name: The Abbot
flavor: Counts each card twice: as it is, and as it could be.
description: Each scored card also adds its Chip value as Mult.

effects.description: On card_scored, add the chips that card just contributed as flat Mult.

name: The Gravekeeper
flavor: The deck gets lighter. He gets stronger. Everyone wins.
description: At the start of each blind, destroy a random deck card. +x0.5 Mult per card destroyed. Now x{counter}.

effects.description: At blind_start, destroy one uniformly random card from the full deck (never below hand size).
